summary: Select the CUDA/Ascend context once per launch instead of again for every bound argument.
regressions: Twelve host device ABI/frame/replay tests pass in 7.849 seconds. Driver shims count context selections and require exactly one per launch while preserving argument ownership, transfers, cleanup and failure checks.
differences: No shader or physics change, no hardware timing claim. Copies/frees and synchronization still activate the owning context at their operation boundary.
